title: Beyond End-to-End Success: Diagnosing Failures in Long-Horizon Security LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.20563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon security LLM agents must carry information and decisions across many dependent interactions, where later actions often depend on services, state, or access discovered much earlier. This makes final task success difficult to interpret: an agent may fail before it ever reaches the point where the capability of interest can be exercised. We present a diagnostic methodology that instruments security tasks with checkpoints, separates failures before and after capability exposure, and uses controlled interventions to test suspected upstream bottlenecks. We evaluate the methodology across four task families involving delayed reuse of discovered information, reuse of observed state, recovery from failed strategies, and decision making after uncertain outcomes. On observed state reuse, checkpoint analysis shows that many Gemini 2.5 Flash failures occur before the model observes the state it is later expected to reuse. In a pre-spec

translated_title: 超越端到端成功：诊断长周期安全LLM智能体的失败
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.20563v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：长周期安全LLM智能体必须在许多相互依赖的交互中携带信息和决策，其中后续行动通常依赖于更早发现的服务、状态或访问权限。这使得最终任务的成功难以解释：智能体可能在达到感兴趣能力可被行使的点之前就失败。我们提出了一种诊断方法，该方法在安全任务中设置检查点，区分能力暴露前后的失败，并使用受控干预来测试可疑的上游瓶颈。我们在四个任务系列中评估了该方法，涉及延迟重用发现的信息、重用观察到的状态、从失败策略中恢复以及在不明确结果后做出决策。在观察到的状态重用方面，检查点分析显示，许多Gemini 2.5 Flash的失败发生在模型观察到其后来预期重用的状态之前。在预规范...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检查点和受控干预的诊断方法，用于定位长周期安全LLM智能体在能力暴露前的失败瓶颈，并通过实验揭示了状态重用类任务中的早期失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a checkpoint-based diagnostic methodology with controlled interventions to localize pre-capability failures in long-horizon security LLM agents, revealing early failure patterns in state-reuse tasks.
